question: 'BELATED' is related to 'TLEEDBA' and 'STOREY is related to 'YTSROE' in the same way as 'DOUBBLE' is related to '______'.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6b07fd0557c31540782a37b7252c5fb9387bfc2d7d3dd19f34eea3a5f0b7f9c.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• BELATED

 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: T > L > E = E > D > B > A
 
• Therefore, code = TLEEDBA
 
 
 
• STOREY 
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: Y > T > S > R > O > E
 
• Therefore, code = YTSROE
 
 
 
• DOUBBLE
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: U > O > L > E > D > B = B
 
• Therefore, code = UOLEDBB
 
 

Hence, ‘**UOLEDBB**’ is the correct answer.
